passive_record_test.target: Existing imposed linear record, using the source-template S of this study
passive_record_test.control: The exact step rule already defines this target: q_next=q+dt*(-0.2*q+0.8*S_next). A six-template fit can approximate the record but cannot establish that the fluid has cubic feedback.

definitions.q_fluid: <u,phi>/norm(AB0) = S/(2 norm(AB0)); independently measured signed coordinate; not historical q_record
definitions.q_record: q_next=q+dt*(-0.2*q+0.8*S_next), q(0)=0. Imposed diagnostic control; not evidence for fluid feedback.
definitions.E: norm(u-M[u])/norm(u); unsigned, not inferred from q

source_features.coefficients: Least-squares spatial projection onto these fixed six templates; same basis for all cases at a grid.
source_features.D_AB: Signed projected nonlinear interactions within the two AB templates.
source_features.D_C: C self interactions and both ordered AB-C interactions.
source_features.D_D: D self interactions and both ordered AB-D interactions.
source_features.D_cross: Both ordered C-D interactions. This is an operational interaction feature, not an established competition-between-pairings mechanism.
source_features.not_exact_closure: Remaining spatial modes and full viscous projection are not supplied to the regressor; target full-fluid derivative is independently computed.

q_record_caution: The imposed linear record is retained as a diagnostic only. Recovering its defining equation is not independent validation.
branch_check: For gamma>=0,g>=0, derivative of the drift in q is -gamma-3g*q^2<=0. Constant inputs cannot produce two isolated stable branches.
scope: Conditional tests use measured held-out input histories. Frozen-input forecasts use no fluid observations after t=.1. Neither closes the full fluid dynamics.
